title: Hunts FH-031S: Put the Event finale on the player and author screens
detail:
FH-031 built the finale read model and its gate (lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts, lib/hunts/rally-finale-store.ts) and nothing calls them from a screen yet. Owed: (1) the author picks the host Event in the Trail editor, limited to Events of the Hunt's own Space or a live partner, and publish writes it to hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id; (2) the player's Trail page shows the finale panel from loadRallyFinale (the Event, places left, the player's seat or the reason there is none, a link to the Event page) and never a button that claims a seat; (3) the first route that grants a completion reward calls grantFinaleReward, and hunt_reward_grant gets the same seat check in SQL so the rule does not rest on one caller; (4) an Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door. Done when a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message on a preview deployment and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Requires FH-016, FH-021 and FH-030. Hunts switches stay OFF.

Built 2026-11-16. (1) Author: the Hunt manifest has a Finale event field and the Trail editor's publish step offers upcoming Events of the Hunt's own Space or of a live partner (lib/hunts/finale-store.ts loadFinaleEventOptions; a Hunt a resident owns with no Space gets the Events its owner hosts). The choice is the draft's finaleEventId, publish writes it to hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id, and publish asks the rule again with rows read now, so a cancelled Event or a partner that withdrew blocks. (2) Player: the Trail page renders components/hunts/finale-panel.tsx from loadRallyFinale: the Event, the places left, the player's seat or the reason there is none, and one link to the Event page. No button, form or input: nothing there can claim a seat. (3) Reward: POST /api/hunts/rewards/grant is the first route that grants a reward (dark behind HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED). It goes through grantRunReward, which sends a completion reward through grantFinaleReward, so a finished player with no seat is refused before the database is called; a reward for named stops keeps its own rule. Migration 20270346085000_hunt_reward_finale_seat.sql (written, NOT applied) puts the same seat check inside hunt_reward_grant, answering not_admitted and writing nothing; the app knows that answer and is correct with or without the migration. Tests: lib/hunts/finale-store.test.ts, components/hunts/finale-panel.test.tsx, app/api/hunts/rewards/grant/route.test.ts (a finished player with no seat at a full Event reads the full message, the grant is never called and no table changed) and supabase/tests/hunt_reward_finale_seat.test.sql. The pgTAP file was not run in the build environment (no database there); CI runs it. Not built, and filed as FH-031T: item (4), an Event stop crediting through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence; a place on the player's page that lists rewards and calls the grant route; applying the migration; and the preview deployment acceptance run this row's Done-when names, which needs a person.
